title: IRT MLE with shinyapps
text: mleirt R package provides interactive Shiny applications demonstrating Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), Expected Posteriori (EAP), Maximum Posteriori (MAP) estimation methods Item Response Theory (IRT). package offers visual interactive tools understanding parameter estimation various IRT models, including Rasch model, 2PL (Two-Parameter Logistic), 3PL (Three-Parameter Logistic) models. Individual plots originally developed Metin Bulus Wes Bonifay, whose work forms foundation visualizations included .

title: IRT MLE with shinyapps
text: Interactive Shiny Interface: Explore IRT concepts dynamic visualizations Rasch Model (person location estimation) 2PL Model (item discrimination difficulty estimation) 3PL Model (item discrimination, difficulty, guessing parameter estimation) Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) Expected Posteriori (EAP) Maximum Posteriori (MAP) Real-time Visualization: Interactive 3D plots showing likelihood surfaces parameter relationships Educational Tool: Ideal teaching learning IRT fundamentals
